supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45:24 UTC, DC-MAP-01 recorded creation of the domain account helpdesk2, attributed to MAPLEHILL\ali.hassan.
At 13:45:34 UTC, DC-MAP-01 recorded helpdesk2 being added to the Administrators group, attributed to MAPLEHILL\ali.hassan with the same subject logon ID as the account-creation event.

The creation and administrator assignment conflict with the provided account-management practices: help-desk temporary accounts use the temp.<name> naming pattern, are added only to Externals, and never receive administrator rights.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not map the account-management subject logon ID 0x807d049 to a source host, address, or interactive session.
The supplied evidence does not include an approval or exception record for creating helpdesk2 or granting it administrator membership.
The records provided do not establish whether helpdesk2 was subsequently used or what access it obtained.
claims_not_established: Whether an authorized, documented exception existed for this account and its administrator membership.
Whether ali.hassan personally performed the recorded account actions or whether the account or credentials were misused.
Whether the account remained enabled or was used after the recorded events.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve DC-MAP-01 logon and process-audit records for subject logon ID 0x807d049 to identify the source session and initiating process.
Check change approvals and help-desk tickets for helpdesk2 and its administrator-group assignment.
Review helpdesk2's current account state, group memberships, and subsequent authentication and access activity.
Investigate the separate RDP session and scheduled-task activity listed under unrelated findings, including the source session and downloaded script.
unrelated_findings: WS-NKIM-01 accepted an RDP logon for ali.hassan from 198.51.100.201; the provided inventory says remote administration is only performed from WS-AHASSAN-01 and there is no VPN. The supplied records do not establish that this session performed the account-management actions. Records: T177-00044, T177-00045, T177-00046.

At 13:45:34 UTC, a task named Microsoft\Windows\HealthCheck was registered on WS-NKIM-01 under ali.hassan. Its hidden PowerShell command contains an encoded web request and execution of a script from http://198.51.100.201/a.ps1. This warrants a separate investigation; the provided evidence does not link it to the account-management logon ID. Records: T177-00066.
